declaration.method: double derivation (spec S2 DD-2): each predicate asserted twice by independent derivations; example bytes, where concrete fixtures are shown, are doubly derived as DD-1 vectors

classes.name: isomorphic-pair
classes.predicate: two independently constructed isomorphic values — distinct construction orders, distinct map-iteration seeds, distinct allocation histories — encode to byte-equal streams over the stable class
covers: backing join is normative and value-determined (WF-24 :968-977)
classes.asserts: byte equality across independently generated isomorphic pairs and map-iteration seeds

classes.name: aliased-backing
classes.predicate: values sharing multi-window backings — array-pointer views, append chains, blob-carried slices — encode independently of allocation and join order; the join truncates to L = max(off_i+extent_i) identically in every conforming implementation
classes.asserts: byte equality across seeds over map-carried multi-window backings with array-pointer views and append chains

classes.name: multi-grain-address
classes.predicate: interior descent and array-grain addresses encode independently of allocation order: each address opens once at its canonical grain — the coarsest among the tracked grains — and every position of that address resolves through it
classes.asserts: interior descent and array-grain addresses encode independently of allocation order
classes.notes: absorbs the four f11-withheld grain rules (derivA2 SENSOR-4 item 3: layout-normal grain, grain tags on canonical-grain vs static-target openings, derivable descent, interface-grain discrimination) as declared predicates; their fixed-byte carriers, if wanted, belong to the topology family form
